title: AI Chat
content: AI Chat The chat gives you access to text neural networks: ask, explain, translate, write code, go through a document or a picture. It differs from the generator fundamentally: the chat is text-only, there are no "Images" or "Video" tabs here, even though the screen layout looks similar. ![AI chat](/assets/docs-pages/screens/07-01-chat-main.en.webp) Three parts: the list of conversations on the left, the conversation in the middle, the settings on the right. title: Coins and limits
content: Coins and limits Everything the service does costs coins: an image, a clip, a voice-over, a chat reply, extracting a prompt from a picture. Coins are a single currency, so you never have to count "how much video is left" separately from "how many pictures are left". How many you have is always visible in the header. title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
content: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) How do I upload my own image for generation? Use the "Your Image" function in the right panel of generation settings. You can upload an image from your device and use it as a basis for further generation. Please note that according to the service rules, you can only upload images that you have rights to. title: Gallery
content: Gallery The gallery is the shared feed of works made by other people, and at the same time the home page of the service. It is worth visiting before the generator: ten minutes here show what neural networks are actually capable of, which models made it and which words describe it. title: Signing in and first steps
content: Signing in and first steps Without signing in you can only browse: the [gallery](/en/docs/gallery) is open, but creating, searching and saving are not. title: When something doesn't work
content: When something doesn't work A troubleshooting page: on the left the symptom as you would describe it yourself, on the right what is actually going on. Almost everything that looks broken isn't. I can't sign in The code doesn't arrive by email. Most likely you pressed "send again" too early: while the previous code is alive, no new email is sent, even though the screen says it was. Open the first email. And check the spam folder.
